Pattern is √(first number) + second number, so √121 + 4 = 11 + 4 = 15 (Option C).
A place observing 6:00 a.m. when IST (82°30' E) is at midnight is 6 hours (+90°) East of IST, at 82°30' + 90° = 172°30' E (Option B).
The SI unit of magnetic flux is Weber (Wb), whereas Farad is the unit of electrical capacitance (Option D).
